title: Isaias ends historic Atlantic hurricane lull after sunny southern summer
summary: In a new weekly update for pv magazine , Solcast, a DNV company, reports that an unusually quiet Atlantic hurricane season brought 10–20% above-average solar irradiance to Mexico and the southern US in August–September, while prolonged dry weather increased solar panel soiling losses. Tropical Storm Isaias is set to end the sunny spell, bringing widespread cloud cover, reduced irradiance, and potential hurricane impacts along the US Gulf Coast. The post Isaias ends historic Atlantic hurricane lull after sunny southern summer appeared first on pv magazine Global .
